gloss_en: the spirit of Mashiach (ruḥo shel Mashiaḥ) — the messianic spirit that hovered over the waters (Genesis 1:2, per the Midrash identifying 'the spirit of God' with the spirit of the Messiah), identified in Likutey Moharan with holy speech, the Shekhinah, the Holy Spirit, and the spirit of zealousness against immorality
